integrity: Proof includes a complete exact finite binary enumeration with standalone C++ source, an independent direct spot checker, and an analytical affine-extension argument; independent scientific audit is not performed.
limitations: Finite exact theorem for one eight-good rank-two laminar key matroid, four agents, and heterogeneous two-level nonnegative additive valuations only. No general additive, twelve-good, or global laminar theorem claimed.
title: Ordered EF1 for all two-level valuations on the eight-good four-agent laminar key matroid
